sentences.text: Today I will talk about a very big and very famous city.
The name of the city is Istanbul.
Istanbul is in the country of Turkey.
Istanbul is a very special city.
Why?
Because it is on two continents.
One side is in Europe, the other side is in Asia.
Only a few cities in the world are like this.
This makes Istanbul very unique.
Istanbul is also a very old city.
It is more than 2,000 years old.
In the past it had different names.
It was called Byzantium and Constantinople.
Many empires lived here like the Roman Empire and the Ottoman Empire.
Today Istanbul is the biggest city in Turkey.
More than 15 million people live there.
It is not the capital of Turkey.
The capital is Ankara, but Istanbul is the most famous city.
There are many things to see in Istanbul.
Let me tell you about some of them.
One famous place is the Hagia Sophia.
It is a big and old building.
It was a church, then a mosque, then a museum.
Now it is a mosque again.
It has big domes and beautiful art inside.
Another place is the Blue Mosque.
It is very close to Hagia Sophia.
The Blue Mosque is also very big and beautiful.
It has six minarets and blue tiles inside.
Many people visit this mosque.
You can also visit the Topkapi Palace.
It was the home of the Ottoman sultans.
There are many rooms, gardens, and beautiful views.
You can take a boat trip on the Bosporus.
The Bosporus is a long waterway.
It goes between Europe and Asia.
From the boat you can see houses, mosques, and bridges.
It is very beautiful, especially at sunset.
Istanbul has many markets.
The most famous one is the Grand Bazaar.
It is a big and old market.
You can buy clothes, bags, spices, tea, and souvenirs there.
It is very colorful and busy.
Now let's talk about food.
Istanbul has amazing food.
You can eat kebabs, maize, and fish.
People also eat cement.
It is round bread with sesame seeds.
It is very popular for breakfast.
You can drink Turkish tea or Turkish coffee.
And for dessert, you can try baklava or lokum, Turkish delight.
They are sweet and very tasty.
There are also modern parts of the city.
You can go shopping in big malls.
You can walk in parks.
You can go to concerts or museums.
Istanbul is old and new at the same time.
People in Istanbul are friendly and helpful.
Many people speak Turkish, but some also speak English.
If you visit Istanbul, you can see history, culture, and nature.
It is a good place for tourists.
Istanbul is busy, loud, and big.
But it is also beautiful, rich in history, and full of life.
I really like Istanbul.
Maybe you will visit one day too.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
